payload.reason: The evidence indicates that while many industrial dialogue systems still rely on handcrafted rules and manual features, there is also mention of using learnable components and machine learning methods, suggesting a mix of approaches rather than solely off-the-shelf NLP systems.

claims.text: Many industrially deployed dialogue systems still use manual features or handcrafted rules, indicating a reliance on traditional methods rather than off-the-shelf NLP systems.
The evidence suggests that hybrid approaches, which may include off-the-shelf NLP systems, are used alongside handcrafted methods in dialogue systems.
